decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and fitting directly into the firm's core coolant-management and innovation program, the invested development effort and public strategic commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge remains tightly aligned with the firm's process-media, efficiency and sustainability positioning, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course now.

As a multi-model extension of the established coolant portfolio that can be bundled into broader system sales, this line benefits from strong portfolio fit and low managerial willingness to admit failure.
After weaker adjacent conveyor products were already removed, the magnetic belt chip conveyor looks like the retained bet in this area, which increases commitment to keep supporting it.
